summary_hint: <borrower(s)> authorized <authorized_company_name> to pull credit for <authorization_purpose>, signed <signature_date>; scope <authorization_scope>, expires <authorization_expiration>.

typed_core.name: borrower_name
typed_core.why: identity: who gave consent; attaches the authorization to a borrower

typed_core.name: borrower_name_2
typed_core.why: identity: co-borrower consent on a joint form

typed_core.name: borrower_ssn_or_itin
typed_core.why: PII (highly_restricted): the SSN/ITIN on the form; MUST be a typed field or it lands unmasked in the catch-all
typed_core.prompt_hint: This form collects SSN/ITIN — highly restricted PII. Extract into borrower_ssn_or_itin (and _2), NEVER into the free-form catch-all

typed_core.name: borrower_ssn_or_itin_2
typed_core.why: PII (highly_restricted): co-borrower SSN/ITIN

typed_core.name: borrower_dob
typed_core.why: PII (highly_restricted): the DOB on the form; MUST be typed, never catch-all
typed_core.prompt_hint: DOB is highly restricted PII. Extract into borrower_dob (and _2), NEVER into the free-form catch-all

typed_core.name: borrower_dob_2
typed_core.why: PII (highly_restricted): co-borrower DOB

typed_core.name: borrower_address
typed_core.why: identity: the borrower address on the form; identity/consistency

typed_core.name: authorized_company_name
typed_core.why: identity / processor: who is authorized to pull — must match this lender/broker; the core consent fact
typed_core.prompt_hint: Capture the authorized company verbatim — a compliance-relevant fact

typed_core.name: authorization_purpose
typed_core.why: processor: mortgage-application purpose — permissible-purpose compliance

typed_core.name: permissible_purpose_statement
typed_core.why: processor: the FCRA permissible-purpose language present on the form — a compliance completeness check
typed_core.prompt_hint: Capture the permissible-purpose statement verbatim — a compliance-relevant fact

typed_core.name: authorization_scope
typed_core.why: processor: what the borrower authorized (single pull vs ongoing) — scope of consent

typed_core.name: authorization_expiration_or_duration
typed_core.why: processor / disambiguator: how long the authorization is valid — whether it is still effective at pull time

typed_core.name: authorized_bureaus_or_report_types
typed_core.why: processor: which bureaus/report types are covered — a light string list, not a wrapped record

typed_core.name: soft_or_hard_inquiry_disclosure
typed_core.why: disambiguator: whether the disclosure states a soft vs hard pull — affects the borrower's credit and the disclosure's adequacy

typed_core.name: borrower_signature_present
typed_core.why: processor: scalar signature-present indicator — is the authorization executed
typed_core.prompt_hint: Assess signature presence as yes/no per borrower; do NOT judge whether the authorization is legally sufficient

typed_core.name: borrower_signature_date
typed_core.why: processor: the consent date — the authorization's effective date and recency

typed_core.name: borrower_signature_date_2
typed_core.why: processor: co-borrower consent date

typed_core.name: issuer_name
typed_core.why: identity: the form's originator (lender/broker) — source

typed_core.name: document_issue_date
typed_core.why: processor: form date; disambiguates from signature date when they differ

typed_core.name: loan_number
typed_core.why: identity: links the authorization to the loan file (confidential)

typed_core.name: property_address
typed_core.why: identity: subject property when stated — loan-file linkage

rejected.name: document_title, form_number, form_revision_date, document_status_or_version
rejected.reason: authorization forms are lender-specific, not standardized

rejected.name: effective_date, expiration_date, statement_period_start, statement_period_end
rejected.reason: duplicate borrower_signature_date / authorization_expiration_or_duration; no coverage period

rejected.name: party_names, party_addresses
rejected.reason: redundant — the parties are the borrowers (borrower_names / borrower_addresses)

rejected.name: account_case_reference_number
rejected.reason: not present on a consent form; keyed by loan_number

rejected.name: signature_blocks, notary_block
rejected.reason: authorization is not notarized; execution captured via borrower_signature_*

rejected.name: authorized_agents_or_service_providers
rejected.reason: no consumer; the authorized party is authorized_company_name — defer to catch-all

rejected.name: initial_and_refresh_pull_authorization
rejected.reason: an object with no consumer; authorization_scope + soft_or_hard_inquiry_disclosure cover the relevant facts

rejected.name: electronic_consent_metadata
rejected.reason: an object with no rule/processor consumer; defer to catch-all

encoding_variations: SSN vs ITIN: the form may label it 'SSN', 'Social Security No.', 'Tax ID', or 'ITIN' — all map to borrower_ssn_or_itin; keep the value, note which in the snippet
Purpose: 'credit for mortgage application', 'pre-qualification', 'loan servicing' — authorization_purpose degrades to text; the permissible-purpose statement disambiguates the FCRA basis
Duration: 'valid for 120 days', 'for the life of the loan', 'until revoked' — authorization_expiration_or_duration holds all forms as text
Soft vs hard: some forms disclose the inquiry type explicitly, some are silent — soft_or_hard_inquiry_disclosure records the disclosure text, not an inference

open_questions.q: No rule consumes this document today (Tier 3, rule_count 0), yet it carries the highest-sensitivity PII in this batch (full SSN + DOB). Even absent a rule, these MUST be typed + registered so they are masked.
open_questions.recommendation: register now regardless of rule status — the PII-protection reason stands alone

options: nested borrowers[] list (with its own PII redactor)
open_questions.recommendation: flatten to two borrowers; revisit to a nested list only if 3+ authorizers on one form prove common

open_questions.q: authorized_bureaus_or_report_types as flat str[] vs nested.
open_questions.recommendation: flat str[] (a handful of bureau names — light, no per-item source needed)

notes: Report each borrower's name, SSN, DOB, and signature date as a matched set (borrower 1 vs borrower 2).
Ambiguity: authorized_bureaus_or_report_types is a flat str[] in the markdown; typed as str with degraded_from 'list' since the five coercers do not include a list type.
borrower_address is promoted to typed core so it is not left raw in the catch-all, but is not registered as a masked PII kind (standard/PII-adjacent).
